purpose: Define exact deletion semantics, tombstones and retention so removal of an active value/record does not silently erase provenance, related source objects or unrelated relation targets.

owns: DWH Delete and Tombstone Semantics semantics

topics.name: DWH Delete and Tombstone Semantics
topics.purpose: Define exact deletion semantics, tombstones and retention so removal of an active value/record does not silently erase provenance, related source objects or unrelated relation targets.

semantics.delete_rule: Delete targets an exact record/resource/value identity.
semantics.soft_rule: Soft-delete/tombstone state is explicit when used.
semantics.hard_rule: Physical/hard deletion is a separately declared retention/destruction operation where supported.
semantics.relation_rule: Delete cascade/restrict/nullify behavior is explicit per relation and never inferred.
semantics.lineage_rule: Required audit/lineage/tombstone evidence may remain without presenting deleted content as active data.
semantics.source_rule: Deleting a materialized/cached copy never deletes its upstream source unless a separate exact authorized operation targets that source.
semantics.authorization_rule: Delete may require stronger/different authority than update.

invariants.rule: Every DWH mutation resolves an exact destination instance/schema/record/field identity, validates intended change, evaluates authorization and conflict state, and records provenance; no write is inferred from query/display context or silently overwrites conflicting accepted state.

hard_gates.condition: delete cascades to relation targets without declared policy
hard delete inferred from ordinary remove

references.purpose: Relation delete behavior must be explicitly declared.
